description: Source code for the DriverCommandFeatureStep class in Spark's Kubernetes resource manager, responsible for creating driver commands and configuring pods for different application types (Java, Python, R).

classes.name: DriverCommandFeatureStep
classes.description: Creates driver commands and configures Spark pods for different application types in Kubernetes.

methods.name: configurePod
methods.description: Configures the SparkPod based on the main application resource type.

methods.name: getAdditionalPodSystemProperties
methods.description: Returns system properties for the Spark pod, indicating the application type.

methods.name: configureForJava
methods.description: Configures the pod for Java applications.

methods.name: environmentVariables
methods.description: Returns environment variables from the system environment.

methods.name: configureForPython
methods.description: Configures the pod for Python applications, setting environment variables.

methods.name: configureForR
methods.description: Configures the pod for R applications.

methods.name: baseDriverContainer
methods.description: Builds the base container for the driver with appropriate arguments.
